subject: Post-discovery: Redwood 30-min demo — scheduling options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@silverline.com>, Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@silverline.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: Redwood 30-min demo — scheduling options

Hi Samir / Alyssa,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to hear more about Silverline's payment orchestration roadmap and the latency/cost sensitivity on peak transaction windows. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary use case: lower-per-token cost for fraud-prevention prompts + unified inference for ranking and chat helpers across merchant services.
- Key constraints: sub-150ms tail latency for user-facing flows, data residency in us-east, and SOC2 evidence review.
- Stakeholders you called out: Eng (Samir), Sec/Compliance (Alyssa), SRE (Jorge) — sounds right.

Next step: we'd like to run a 30-minute demo + technical deep dive focused on throughput/latency for your workload and an initial rollout plan. Below are 3 options — all times in US/Pacific (PDT) with UTC in parentheses so it's easy to calendar: 

1) Tue Oct 13, 10:00–10:30 AM PDT (17:00–17:30 UTC)
2) Wed Oct 14, 2:00–2:30 PM PDT (21:00–21:30 UTC) 
3) Thu Oct 15, 11:30–12:00 PM PDT (18:30–19:00 UTC)

Camila (cc'd) will run the technical portion and demos live on a sandbox instance. Attached is a short agenda we typically use (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf). Can you confirm which slot works or share 2–3 alternatives that fit your team?

If helpful, we can include a quick pre-demo checklist: a short list of sample queries, expected p95 sequence lengths, and any current infra notes (cloud provider + region).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on calendar.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@silverline.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@silverline.com>, Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@silverline.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Redwood 30-min demo — scheduling options

Thanks Marissa — great summary and really appreciate the agenda. Slot 2 (Wed Oct 14, 2:00–2:30 PM PDT) works best for our group. I'll be joined by Alyssa (security/compliance) and Jorge (SRE).

Two quick asks before the demo:
- Can Camila surface any prior latency/cost numbers for a payments fraud model at ~1k TPS? Even rough ballpark helps the internal pre-read.
- We may want a short bit on data residency and audit logging — Alyssa will prepare a few questions.

Please send a calendar invite when you have a moment.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Director of Engineering, Silverline FinTech
samir.patel@silverline.com
